cues.text: In a sitting room of the vacation home, everyone sits on sofas around a low table: you, Yukari and Mitsuru on one side, Junpei, Fuuka and Akihiko on the other. Facing you all sits the man with the eyepatch, his arms folded.
Takeharu unfolds his arms and leans forward. A switch clicks and a projector starts up. Everyone turns to look at it.
